airport: An airport features expansive smooth gray runways with clear white markings, large terminal buildings, and extensive aprons with parked aircraft, distinguishing it from the complex water boundaries with linear dock structures of harbors, the large flat gray paved surfaces with regular parking grids of parking lots, and the dense clusters of medium-to-large rectangular buildings of commercial areas.
airplane: An airplane appears as a compact, bright metallic cross-shaped object with sharply defined wings and fuselage on a uniform gray tarmac surface, distinguishing it from the large bright elongated objects moored in water of ships, the clusters of perfectly circular bright metallic cylindrical structures of storage tanks, and the long wide strips of smooth uniform gray pavement of runways.
baseball_diamond: A baseball diamond features a distinctive fan-shaped green outfield with a diamond-shaped dirt infield and a circular arc boundary, distinguishing it from the small precisely rectangular surfaces with crisp white lines of tennis courts, the large oval or rectangular enclosed structures with tiered seating of stadiums, and the precisely rectangular bright green turf surfaces with white boundary lines of ground track fields.
basketball_court: A basketball court is a small, precisely rectangular surface with distinctive orange or brown coloring, crisp white boundary lines, and a visible center circle and key areas, distinguishing it from the small precisely rectangular surfaces with white boundary lines and a central net of tennis courts, the large precisely rectangular bright green turf surfaces of football fields, and the large flat gray paved surfaces with regular parking grids of parking lots.
beach: A beach appears as a broad, smooth expanse of fine light tan sand with a gentle natural transition to water and subtle wave patterns along the shoreline, distinguishing it from the sinuous naturally curving ribbon of dark smooth water of rivers, the vast uniform pale yellow sand with wind-formed ripple textures of deserts, and the complex water boundaries with linear dock structures of harbors.
bridge: A bridge appears as a linear elevated structure crossing perpendicularly over a dark water body with visible support pillars and shadow patterns on the water surface below, distinguishing it from the long continuous elevated linear concrete structure with regular support pillars of viaducts, the complex water boundaries with linear dock structures of harbors, and the sinuous naturally curving ribbon of dark smooth water of rivers.
chaparral: Chaparral exhibits a dense, rough, and uneven texture of low-lying shrubby vegetation with irregular brownish-green tones and no organized geometric pattern, distinguishing it from the large regularly gridded patches of crop rows of rectangular farmland, the broad smooth expanse of fine light tan sand of beaches, and the dense continuous dark green canopy with clumpy texture of forests.
church: A church features a distinctive rectangular building with a prominent tall steeple or spire, often with a cross-shaped floor plan visible from above, surrounded by small parking areas and open space, distinguishing it from the dense cluster of tall varied-size buildings of urban centers, the large flat gray paved surfaces with parking lines of parking lots, and the grand symmetrical architectural layouts with large courtyards of palaces.
circular_farmland: Circular farmland displays large circular crop patterns created by center-pivot irrigation systems with radiating linear textures and alternating green and brown tones, distinguishing it from the flat rectangular gridded patches of crops with distinct linear row patterns of rectangular farmland, the stepped parallel linear agricultural patterns following terrain contours of terraces, and the broad uniform expanse of bright green grass of meadows.
cloud: A cloud appears as a large, soft-edged, bright white mass with smooth billowy or wispy texture casting diffuse shadows on the ground below, distinguishing it from the bright white angular ice formations floating in dark ocean water of snowbergs, the vast smooth continuous pale surfaces of sea ice, and the broad flat expanse of uniform light brown soil of barelands.
commercial_area: Commercial areas display dense clusters of medium-to-large rectangular buildings with flat rooftops, extensive paved parking lots between structures, and regular street grids, distinguishing them from the large rectangular factory buildings with storage tanks of industrial areas, the tightly packed small rectangular rooftops with minimal spacing of dense residential areas, and the large flat gray paved surfaces with regular parking grids of parking lots.
dense_residential: Dense residential areas show tightly packed small rectangular rooftops with minimal spacing, narrow streets, and very limited green space between buildings, distinguishing them from the moderately spaced houses with visible yards and regular street grids of medium residential areas, the widely scattered individual houses with abundant vegetation of sparse residential areas, and the many small uniformly sized narrow rectangular structures in tight parallel rows of mobile home parks.
desert: A desert presents a vast, uniform expanse of light tan or pale yellow sand with subtle wind-formed ripple textures and no vegetation, distinguishing it from the broad flat expanse of uniform light brown soil of barelands, the smooth light tan sand with gentle water transition of beaches, and the rugged irregular topography with varied rock tones of mountains.
forest: A forest exhibits a dense, continuous dark green canopy with a fine-grained rough clumpy texture showing no geometric structure or regular pattern, distinguishing it from the rugged irregular topography with varied rock tones and elevation changes of mountains, the broad uniform expanse of bright green grass of meadows, and the large regularly gridded patches of crop rows of rectangular farmland.
freeway: A freeway appears as a long, wide strip of smooth dark gray pavement with multiple parallel lane markings and consistent linear geometry, distinguishing it from the long continuous elevated linear concrete structure with regular support pillars of viaducts, the sinuous naturally curving ribbon of dark smooth water of rivers, and the one or more parallel thin linear tracks with regular cross-beam patterns of railways.
golf_course: A golf course features large expanses of manicured bright green turf with scattered sand bunkers, winding cart paths, and irregularly shaped greens and small water hazards, distinguishing it from the large regularly gridded patches of crop rows of rectangular farmland, the broad uniform expanse of bright green grass of meadows, and the dense rough uneven texture of low-lying shrubby vegetation of chaparral.
ground_track_field: A ground track field displays a distinctive oval-shaped reddish-brown or blue running track surrounding a central rectangular green grass field with clear lane markings, distinguishing it from the small precisely rectangular surfaces with orange or brown coloring of basketball courts, the broad uniform expanse of bright green grass of meadows, and the fan-shaped green outfield with diamond-shaped dirt infield of baseball diamonds.
harbor: A harbor contains complex water boundaries with linear dock structures, moored ships appearing as large bright elongated objects, cranes, and extensive paved storage areas, distinguishing it from the large bright elongated objects with pointed bows leaving visible wake trails of ships, the large flat gray paved surfaces with regular grids of thin white parking lines of parking lots, and the many small uniformly sized narrow rectangular structures arranged in tight parallel rows of mobile home parks.
industrial_area: Industrial areas display large rectangular factory buildings with flat rooftops, clusters of circular storage tanks, wide internal roads, and minimal vegetation, distinguishing them from the large flat gray paved surfaces with regular grids of thin white parking lines of parking lots, the clusters of perfectly circular uniform-sized bright metallic or white cylindrical structures of storage tanks, and the large industrial buildings with prominent tall cylindrical cooling towers emitting steam of thermal power stations.
intersection: An intersection displays a clear crossing pattern of two or more paved roads with visible lane markings and traffic infrastructure at the junction, distinguishing it from the long wide strip of smooth dark gray pavement with multiple parallel lane markings of freeways, the circular paved road intersection with a central island surrounded by connecting roads of roundabouts, and the large flat gray paved surfaces with regular parking grids of parking lots.
island: An island appears as a distinct landmass completely surrounded by dark smooth water with irregular natural shoreline and vegetation cover, distinguishing it from the complex water boundaries with linear dock structures of harbors, the sinuous naturally curving ribbon of dark smooth water of rivers, and the large enclosed relatively smooth dark or blue-green water body of lakes.
lake: A lake appears as a large, enclosed, relatively smooth dark or blue-green water body with a natural irregular shoreline surrounded by land, distinguishing it from the sinuous naturally curving ribbon of dark smooth water with irregular banks of rivers, the small enclosed roughly circular dark smooth water body of ponds, and the complex water boundaries with linear dock structures of harbors.
meadow: A meadow presents a broad, uniform expanse of bright green grass with a smooth fine texture and no visible geometric patterns, markings, or structures, distinguishing it from the large regularly gridded patches of crop rows with alternating color bands of rectangular farmland, the large circular crop patterns created by center-pivot irrigation of circular farmland, and the dense continuous dark green canopy with clumpy texture of forests.
medium_residential: Medium residential areas feature moderately spaced single-family houses with visible yards, a regular street grid, and a balanced mix of rooftops and green space, distinguishing them from the many small uniformly sized narrow rectangular structures arranged in tight parallel rows of mobile home parks, the tightly packed small rectangular rooftops with minimal spacing and narrow streets of dense residential areas, and the widely scattered individual houses with abundant surrounding vegetation and large gaps between structures of sparse residential areas.
mobile_home_park: A mobile home park consists of many small, uniformly sized narrow rectangular structures arranged in tight parallel rows with minimal green space, distinguishing it from the moderately spaced single-family houses with visible yards and regular street grids of medium residential areas, the large flat gray paved surfaces with regular grids of thin white parking lines of parking lots, and the clusters of perfectly circular uniform-sized bright metallic cylindrical structures of storage tanks.
mountain: Mountain terrain displays rugged, irregular topography with varied tones of rock and sparse vegetation, showing natural contour patterns and shadow variations from elevation changes, distinguishing it from the dense continuous dark green canopy with clumpy texture of forests, the vast uniform pale yellow sand with wind-formed ripple textures of deserts, and the broad flat expanse of uniform light brown soil of barelands.
overpass: An overpass appears as an elevated linear concrete structure crossing perpendicularly over another road or feature, casting distinct shadows on the surface below, distinguishing it from the long wide strip of smooth dark gray pavement with multiple parallel lane markings of freeways, the linear elevated structure crossing perpendicularly over a dark water body of bridges, and the long continuous elevated linear concrete structure with regular support pillars of viaducts.
palace: A palace features grand symmetrical architectural layouts with large courtyards, ornate rooftops, and extensive structured gardens, distinguishing it from the dense cluster of tall varied-size rectangular buildings of urban centers, the distinctive rectangular buildings with prominent tall steeples or spires of churches, and the moderately spaced houses with visible yards and regular street grids of medium residential areas.
parking_lot: A parking lot presents a large flat gray paved surface with a regular grid of thin white parking space lines and scattered small dark vehicle rectangles, distinguishing it from the complex water boundaries with linear dock structures and moored ships of harbors, the large rectangular factory buildings with flat rooftops and clusters of circular storage tanks of industrial areas, and the many small uniformly sized narrow rectangular structures arranged in tight parallel rows of mobile home parks.
railway: A railway appears as one or more parallel thin linear tracks with regular cross-beam patterns running through the landscape, distinguishing it from the long wide strip of smooth dark gray pavement with multiple parallel lane markings of freeways, the long continuous elevated linear concrete structure with regular support pillars of viaducts, and the multiple parallel linear railway tracks with platforms of railway stations.
railway_station: A railway station features multiple parallel linear railway tracks with platforms, adjacent station buildings, and surrounding structures, distinguishing it from the large rectangular factory buildings with flat rooftops and clusters of circular storage tanks of industrial areas, the expansive smooth gray runways with clear white markings and terminal buildings of airports, and the long continuous elevated linear concrete structure with regular support pillars of viaducts.
rectangular_farmland: Rectangular farmland displays large, regularly gridded patches of crops with distinct linear row patterns, alternating color bands of green and brown, and clear geometric rectangular field boundaries, distinguishing it from the large circular crop patterns created by center-pivot irrigation of circular farmland, the stepped parallel linear agricultural patterns following terrain contours of terraces, and the broad uniform expanse of bright green grass of meadows.
river: A river appears as a sinuous, naturally curving ribbon of dark smooth water with irregular banks and variable width flowing through the landscape, distinguishing it from the large enclosed relatively smooth dark or blue-green water body of lakes, the small enclosed roughly circular dark smooth water body of ponds, and the complex water boundaries with linear dock structures of harbors.
roundabout: A roundabout appears as a circular paved road intersection with a central island, surrounded by connecting roads forming a continuous loop, distinguishing it from the clear crossing pattern of two or more paved roads of intersections, the large circular crop patterns created by center-pivot irrigation of circular farmland, and the distinctive oval-shaped running track surrounding a central rectangular green field of ground track fields.
runway: A runway is a very long, wide, straight strip of smooth uniform gray pavement with centralized markings and surrounded by flat open tarmac, distinguishing it from the compact bright metallic cross-shaped object with sharply defined wings of airplanes, the long wide strip of smooth dark gray pavement with multiple parallel lane markings of freeways, and the elevated linear concrete structure crossing perpendicularly over another road of overpasses.
sea_ice: Sea ice presents a vast, smooth, bright white to pale blue surface with subtle fracture lines and floating ice floe patterns, distinguishing it from the large soft-edged bright white mass with smooth billowy texture of clouds, the large bright white angular ice formations floating in dark ocean water of snowbergs, and the broad flat expanse of uniform light brown soil of barelands.
ship: A ship appears as a large, bright elongated rectangular or triangular object with a pointed bow on dark water, leaving a visible wake trail, distinguishing it from the complex water boundaries with linear dock structures of harbors, the compact bright metallic cross-shaped object with sharply defined wings of airplanes, and the large flat gray paved surfaces with regular parking grids of parking lots.
snowberg: A snowberg appears as a large, bright white, angular ice formation floating in dark ocean water with sharp geometric edges and visible calving faces, distinguishing it from the vast smooth continuous pale surfaces with subtle fracture lines of sea ice, the large soft-edged bright white mass with smooth billowy texture of clouds, and the broad smooth expanse of fine light tan sand of beaches.
sparse_residential: Sparse residential areas show widely scattered individual houses with abundant surrounding vegetation and large gaps between structures, distinguishing them from the tightly packed small rectangular rooftops with minimal spacing of dense residential areas, the moderately spaced single-family houses with visible yards and regular street grids of medium residential areas, and the dense continuous dark green canopy with clumpy texture of forests.
stadium: A stadium displays a large oval or rectangular enclosed structure with tiered seating visible as concentric rings, a central green field, and surrounding parking areas, distinguishing it from the distinctive fan-shaped green outfield with diamond-shaped dirt infield of baseball diamonds, the dense cluster of tall varied-size rectangular buildings of urban centers, and the small precisely rectangular surfaces with sports court markings of playgrounds.
storage_tank: Storage tanks appear as a cluster of perfectly circular, uniform-sized bright metallic or white cylindrical structures with consistent shadows, distinguishing them from the large rectangular factory buildings with flat rooftops of industrial areas, the small enclosed roughly circular dark smooth water body of ponds, and the many small uniformly sized narrow rectangular structures arranged in tight parallel rows of mobile home parks.
tennis_court: A tennis court is a small, precisely rectangular surface with crisp white boundary lines, a central net line, and a uniform colored interior often surrounded by fencing, distinguishing it from the small precisely rectangular surfaces with distinctive orange or brown coloring and a visible center circle of basketball courts, the large precisely rectangular bright green turf surfaces with white boundary lines of football fields, and the large flat gray paved surfaces with regular parking grids of parking lots.
terrace: Terraces display stepped, parallel linear agricultural patterns following natural terrain contours with alternating vegetation bands on sloped land, distinguishing them from the flat rectangular gridded patches of crops with distinct linear row patterns of rectangular farmland, the large circular crop patterns created by center-pivot irrigation of circular farmland, and the rugged irregular topography with varied tones of rock of mountains.
thermal_power_station: A thermal power station features large industrial buildings with prominent tall cylindrical cooling towers emitting steam and clusters of smokestacks, distinguishing it from the clusters of perfectly circular uniform-sized bright metallic or white cylindrical structures of storage tanks, the large rectangular factory buildings with flat rooftops of industrial areas, and the sinuous naturally curving ribbon of dark smooth water of rivers.
wetland: A wetland displays an irregular mosaic of shallow water, mudflats, and dense marsh vegetation with a patchy mixed texture of dark water and green-brown plant clusters, distinguishing it from the large enclosed relatively smooth dark or blue-green water body of lakes, the sinuous naturally curving ribbon of dark smooth water of rivers, and the broad uniform expanse of bright green grass of meadows.
